caseNameFull: Eighth Avenue Railroad Company v. Job E. Hedges, as Receiver of the New York Railways Company and Ninth Avenue Railroad Company v. Job E. Hedges, as Receiver of the New York Railways Company
attorneys: Mr. Michel Kirkland and Mr. Morgan J. O’Brien for appellants. Mr. Walter Howe and Mr. Bronson Winthrop for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Shulthis v. McDougal, 225 U. S. 561, 568; Hull v. Burr, 234 U. S. 712, 720; Delaware, Lackawanna & Western R. R. Co. v. Yurkonis, 238 U. S. 439, 444; Begg v. City of New York, ante, 196.
